title: Enter Relationships
coreMove: Stillness grows in relationship when you share what matters, let trusted people mirror you, and stay open when connection corrects the self.

exampleSpecs.audience: learners who confuse private mastery with wisdom
exampleSpecs.stakes: turn a confusing Stoic line into a shared skill
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Alma makes Seneca's sharing principle visible through one taught color move

exampleSpecs.audience: people who protect calm by staying sealed off
exampleSpecs.stakes: show how one shared act changes the same stressful process
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the same crowded meal changes when Nila shares attention instead of guarding calm

exampleSpecs.audience: people reviewing feedback that feels personal
exampleSpecs.stakes: let one specific find become behavior change
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a rehearsal note reveals self-absorption in conversation

exampleSpecs.stakes: let a private thought sequence receive a relational correction
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Asha thinks through a group comment without hiding from it

exampleSpecs.audience: helpers planning scarce attention before a busy shift
exampleSpecs.stakes: allocate time so value becomes shared instead of merely efficient
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Imani allocates scarce attention before action begins

exampleSpecs.audience: people who fear relational correction will wound trust
exampleSpecs.stakes: choose between two bad options during a tired family planning moment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Sanaa faces a genuine two-bad-options correction moment
